summary: Discusses how IETF working groups typically handle the documents they work on. It focuses on the common practice of adopting an existing draft as a starting point, which may be anything from a widely used specification to a blank sheet. It is informational guidance, not a formal process rule.

eli5.summary: A club wants to write a rulebook. This document explains the usual ways they pick a first draft to start from and then keep improving it together.

questions: how do ietf working groups adopt drafts
how are internet-drafts handled in a working group
